allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge: about a metre within 10 to 20 years. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: pads blue-green flushed violet to deep purple in cold and drought, drawn purple; few or no long spines, reddish brown where present, and brown glochids. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): its tepals on a spiral (16 by hand: no flora counts them, and USDA GRIN records 9 to 22 petals on accessions of Opuntia, as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read) on a floral cup above the inferior ovary, from the characters of Cactaceae by the rules at the flowering plants. Its 200 stamens by hand, the most a flower draws, for the numerous ones every flora gives.

appearance.bodies.stem.spines.radial.cou.note: Spec rework E6c: the cacti's ribs, areoles and spines grown from the characters their floras state, in each body look that has ribs or a spine set of that role.

appearance.bodies.stem.spines.radial.len.note: Spec rework E6c: the cacti's ribs, areoles and spines grown from the characters their floras state, in each body look that has ribs or a spine set of that role.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.corolla.note: How PlantGen draws a flower, a choice of the model's (spec rework P5): the flower characters set a flower card's perianth, its parts, how they differ by place, how far the corolla is joined into a tube, a floral cup, where the ovary sits, a resupinate flower's turn, its stamens, staminodes and carpels and its spurs. generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an upright shrub about a metre tall of round pads 10 to 20 cm across. Yellow flowers with red centres along the top of the pads in spring. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.params.dioecious.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant bears both sexes, unless its taxa state it dioecious.

generator.params.joints.note: Spec rework E6c: the joints of chollas and prickly pears from their stated form and size.

generator.params.pad.note: Spec rework E6c: a prickly pear's joints drawn as pads.

generator.params.sex.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant's sex is its own draw, dealt across a package's seeds so that both sexes grow; the typical plant (sex 0.5) is female, so it shows its fruit.

generator.program.note: The cacti's own program (growth plan G2.3a): columns, barrels and chains of joints, their ribs, areoles and spines from each species' look.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Common name (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.genus.note: The genus WCVP v16's accepted name is written in.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

taxon.scientific_name.note: WCVP v16's accepted name for the plant the spec's authors wrote as Opuntia santa-rita, which WCVP treats as a synonym.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (milestone F1). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
